decisions.summary: Five write sessions each with a check-and-apply session, sequential in one clone, in the issue's priority order (Q1 Japan then China, Q3, Q2, Q4); each pair landed on its own; then the reply on #24; no code, map or canon change.
decisions.why: Carries the issue's stated priority and region order (FR-004) and the research-only scope of money-requests.md.

decisions.summary: The passes are leads; every passage is read on its page (archive-find, source-pages) before citing; scrambled-scan tables are read on the page image and given to the checks.
decisions.why: Spec edge case on machine-read scans and the findings' 'leads until read on the page'.

decisions.summary: Pass A's nothing-found/rejected ledger rows that bear on the question are superseded with cited:<key> by the session that cites them.
decisions.why: Record bookkeeping under FR-002; drops nothing asked.

decisions.summary: Nine new questions (D1 2, D2 1, D3 2, D4 2, D5 2), each under 20,000 bytes; at most four questions and ten keys per write session, the rest to a continuation; no finding dropped for the cap.
decisions.why: The spec leaves the count to the plan; the cap defers, never drops, a finding.

decisions.summary: Coin silver from 0287/0289, koku of burthen as the source converts it, a distance from the source or else measured and labeled as this project's.
Performance bookends N/A; constitution check: question tasks research: physical, record CHECK=1 green.

Japan Q1 in two questions (silk and iron; sugar and tea), each good with source units, ratio, distance and route, g silver/kg as labeled arithmetic, the source's account of the gap; neighbors with the question whose route they share; the new questions point at 0282 and 0283.
decisions.why: Every good the issue names for Japan is carried with the figures it asks; the gap's make-up serves the canon comparison (kiln price plus freight, tariff and margin).

decisions.summary: China Q1 in one question: tea to Canton and Shanghai with the gap itemized, Beijing silent as a pair; raw silk silent; Taiwan sugar and Takow-Yokohama; Guangdong sugar silent; spices etc one-end only; points at D1 and 0283's Bohea tea.
decisions.why: Each China good the issue names is carried with a verdict.

decisions.summary: Q3 in two questions: the wholesaler (commissions, the buying house's markup, net margin silent, Qing brokerage silent, Hong margin) and the shipowner on own account (return per voyage, against carrying for hire, voyages a year, crew split, loss to wreck, Chinese cargoes, interest beside the canon).
decisions.why: Every part of Q3 (a) and (b), the voyages count and China are carried; split and wreck loss are costs inside 'what a merchant kept after costs'.

decisions.summary: Q2 in two questions (Japan, China): rates in source units, voyage days, Osaka-Edo silence beyond 0280, silver per 100 kg per 100 km as labeled arithmetic where a distance can be stated, comparison with 0280's river and pack-horse rates; a pointer from 0280.
decisions.why: Every route, figure and the comparison the issue asks are carried; the per-distance figure is SILENT only where no distance can be stated, per FR-005/FR-007.

decisions.summary: Q4: 'charter's silence with how hire was paid' - charter recorded as SILENT in both countries.
decisions.why: Q4 asks 'what chartering one cost (silver per voyage or month)'. Pass D C2(a) (Matsuura, thesis Part 1 ch. 3) holds a Ninghai junk chartered whole for a voyage in 1862: 400-odd taels Ninghai-Niuzhuang, 535 taels Niuzhuang-Jiangnan. That is a per-voyage charter of a Chinese coastal junk (not a sand junk), so the figure is ATTESTED ONLY FOR that junk; pre-deciding SILENT drops an answer the passes hold. None of the three conditions for an exception applies.

decisions.summary: Q4 otherwise: burthen by class and period, crew by size, crew pay, build cost, working life; the disputed essay author and the two unreconciled state rates both given.
decisions.why: Every Q4 figure carried; FR-007 on disagreement.

decisions.summary: Pointers: D4 adds a pointer FROM 0280; D1 and D2 only point AT 0283; no block (and no task) adds the pointer from 0283 that FR-002 requires.
decisions.why: FR-002 of the spec under review: 'pointed at from 0280 and 0283'. The plan carries 0280 and silently drops 0283; nothing physically prevents it, nothing in the request implies it, and it defeats FR-002's purpose of reaching the new answers from 0283 (a famous good far from home), the question the issue builds on.

decisions.summary: implementation-check.md lines per question; the reply on #24 question by question and figure by figure in priority order with fragment file, verdict, what is open and the canon beside; escalation-check for the GM; no canon edit.
decisions.why: FR-001, FR-003, FR-004, FR-008 and money-requests.md's answer form.
